theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpo_slice_coords
theorems.statement: ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ L : (ℝ × Euclid N) ≃L[ℝ] Euclid (N + 1), (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N), L (t, x) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) ∧ L (1, 0) = EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 ∧ ∀ x : Euclid N, ‖L (0, x)‖ = ‖x‖
